scope: Observation-only conditional-Jcc successor-run view on pinned Windows 3.11 60M and stock xv6 4 MiB forktest

validation.focusedTests: 14/14 pass, including taken/fallthrough short and near Jcc, 16-bit target wrap, redirect/event, identity/page/mode boundaries, unchanged unlinked counters and histogram partitions
validation.unlinkedCounters: Byte-for-byte equal to the prior Windows and xv6 broad-block potential census mode objects on both full workloads
validation.partitions: For each mode, linked histogram counts and end reasons equal runs; histogram length-weighted counts equal potential steps; joined plus refused Jcc equal attempts; >=4 and >=8 run/step tails reconcile with the histogram; successor-page totals equal outcome-specific page totals.

gate.predeclared: Mean >=4 potential steps per linked run and >=50% potential completed-step coverage on both workloads
gate.result: No-go: coverage clears 50%, but Windows mean 2.557 and xv6 mean 3.577 both miss four.
gate.interpretation: A syntactic upper bound from ordinary observed step calls, not a native safety proof or CPU-time share. Diagnostic host timings are not speed evidence; no executable branch-link optimization is proposed.
